182     error: extra.error ?? code.toLowerCase().replace(/_/g, '-'),

184     status: code,

186     message: text,
187     spine: true,

246 /**
247  * Bounded read of roadmap_events (never returns more than ROADMAP_EVENTS_MAX).
248  * Empty-but-valid and unreadable are SEPARATE named states.
249  *
250  * @param {string} projectPath
251  * @param {{ limit?: number, offset?: number }} [opts]
252  */
253 export function readRoadmapEventsBounded(projectPath, opts = {}) {
254   const ledgerPath = roadmapLedgerPath(projectPath);
255   if (!fs.existsSync(ledgerPath)) {
256     return {
257       ok: true,
258       code: SPINE_CODE.LEDGER_EMPTY,
259       status: SPINE_CODE.LEDGER_EMPTY,
260       text: SPINE_TEXT[SPINE_CODE.LEDGER_EMPTY],
261       message: SPINE_TEXT[SPINE_CODE.LEDGER_EMPTY],
262       events: [],
263       count: 0,
264       bound: ROADMAP_EVENTS_MAX,
265       exists: false,
266     };
267   }
268   let raw;
269   try {
270     raw = fs.readFileSync(ledgerPath, 'utf8');
271   } catch (e) {
272     return spineFailure(SPINE_CODE.LEDGER_UNREADABLE, {
273       error: 'backing-store-unreadable',
274       detail: String(e?.message ?? e),
275     });
276   }
277   let roadmap;
278   try {
279     roadmap = JSON.parse(raw);
280   } catch (e) {
281     return spineFailure(SPINE_CODE.LEDGER_UNREADABLE, {
282       error: 'backing-store-unreadable',
283       detail: String(e?.message ?? e),
284     });
285   }
286   if (!roadmap || typeof roadmap !== 'object' || Array.isArray(roadmap)) {
287     return spineFailure(SPINE_CODE.STATE_UNKNOWN, {
288       error: 'unknown',
289     });
290   }
291   const all = Array.isArray(roadmap.roadmap_events) ? roadmap.roadmap_events : [];
292   if (all.length === 0) {
293     return {
294       ok: true,
295       code: SPINE_CODE.LEDGER_EMPTY,
296       status: SPINE_CODE.LEDGER_EMPTY,
297       text: SPINE_TEXT[SPINE_CODE.LEDGER_EMPTY],
298       message: SPINE_TEXT[SPINE_CODE.LEDGER_EMPTY],
299       events: [],
300       count: 0,
301       bound: ROADMAP_EVENTS_MAX,
302       exists: true,
303       roadmap,
304     };
305   }
306   const offset = Math.max(0, Number(opts.offset) || 0);
307   const limit = Math.min(
308     ROADMAP_EVENTS_MAX,
309     Math.max(0, opts.limit != null ? Number(opts.limit) : ROADMAP_EVENTS_MAX),
310   );
311   const slice = all.slice(offset, offset + limit);
312   return {
313     ok: true,
314     code: null,
315     status: null,
316     events: slice,
317     count: all.length,
318     offset,
319     limit,
320     bound: ROADMAP_EVENTS_MAX,
321     exists: true,
322     roadmap,
323   };
324 }

332   if (!clientEventId || typeof clientEventId !== 'string') return null;

337 /**
338  * Pure append law used under the lock (and by pure callers via roadmap.mjs).
339  * Re-exported for tests that assert the spine owns the production path.
340  *
341  * @param {object|string|null} roadmapInput
342  * @param {object} event
343  * @param {{ at?: string }} [opts]
344  */
345 export function appendRoadmapEventSpineLaw(roadmapInput, event, opts = {}) {
346   const storeGate = assertStoreDeclared('roadmap_events');
347   if (!storeGate.ok) return storeGate;
348 
349   if (!event || typeof event !== 'object' || Array.isArray(event)) {
350     return spineFailure(SPINE_CODE.STATE_UNKNOWN, {
351       error: 'event_not_object',
352     });
353   }
354 
355   const kindGate = assertEventKindAllowed(event.kind);
356   if (!kindGate.ok) return kindGate;
357 
358   // Seed / parse base
359   const base =
360     roadmapInput == null || roadmapInput === undefined
361       ? emptyRoadmap()
362       : roadmapInput;
363 
364   // Bound check before pure append (also enforced inside pure path)
365   let eventCount = 0;
366   if (typeof base === 'string') {
367     try {
368       const p = JSON.parse(base);
369       eventCount = Array.isArray(p?.roadmap_events) ? p.roadmap_events.length : 0;
370     } catch {
371       eventCount = 0;
372     }
373   } else if (base && typeof base === 'object') {
374     eventCount = Array.isArray(base.roadmap_events) ? base.roadmap_events.length : 0;
375   }
376 
377   // Idempotence: same client_event_id → no-op, original seq
378   if (typeof event.client_event_id === 'string' && event.client_event_id.trim()) {
379     const parsed =
380       typeof base === 'string'
381         ? (() => {
382             try {
383               return JSON.parse(base);
384             } catch {
385               return null;
386             }
387           })()
388         : base;
389     const prior = findEventByClientId(parsed, event.client_event_id);
390     if (prior) {
391       if (event.kind === 'refinement_update' && (prior.kind !== event.kind || prior.request_digest !== event.request_digest)) {
392         return {ok:false,error:'operation-id-collision',committed:false};
393       }
394       return {
395         ok: true,
396         idempotent: true,
397         client_event_id: event.client_event_id,
398         seq: prior.seq,
399         event: prior,
400         roadmap: parsed,
401         projection: parsed?.roadmap_projection ?? [],
402         spine: true,
403         single_writer: SPINE_SINGLE_WRITER,
404       };
405     }
406   }
407 
408   if (eventCount >= ROADMAP_EVENTS_MAX) {
409     return spineFailure(SPINE_CODE.EVENTS_BOUND, {
410       error: 'events-bound-exceeded',
411       bound: ROADMAP_EVENTS_MAX,
412       count: eventCount,
413     });
414   }
415 
416   const result = appendRoadmapEvent(base, event, opts);
417   if (!result.ok) {
418     // Preserve pure-law error identity (unknown_roadmap_event_kind,
419     // status_flip_requires_receipt, …). Stamp spine code only for bound.
420     if (result.error === 'events-bound-exceeded') {
421       return spineFailure(SPINE_CODE.EVENTS_BOUND, {
422         error: 'events-bound-exceeded',
423         bound: ROADMAP_EVENTS_MAX,
424         count: result.count,
425       });
426     }
427     if (result.error === 'unknown_roadmap_event_kind') {
428       return {
429         ...result,
430         spine: true,
431         code: SPINE_CODE.KIND_REFUSED,
432         status: SPINE_CODE.KIND_REFUSED,
433         text: SPINE_TEXT[SPINE_CODE.KIND_REFUSED],
434         allowed: [...SPINE_EVENT_KINDS],
435         kinds_version: ROADMAP_EVENT_KINDS_VERSION,
436       };
437     }
438     return { ...result, spine: true };
439   }
440   return {
441     ...result,
442     spine: true,
443     idempotent: false,
444     seq: result.event?.seq ?? null,
445     single_writer: SPINE_SINGLE_WRITER,
446   };
447 }

463 /**
464  * THE production append: load under lock → append → atomic whole-file rewrite.
465  *
466  * When `opts.project_id` is set and `opts.skip_index` is not true, also writes
467  * the inventory-v1 carrier and flushes the portfolio index (closing Wave-3's
468  * pre-decided FAIL: appendRoadmapEventDurable gains production callers).
469  *
470  * @param {string} projectPath
471  * @param {object} event
472  * @param {{
473  *   project_id?: string,
474  *   home?: string,
475  *   paths?: object,
476  *   env?: object,
477  *   at?: string,
478  *   seed?: object|string|null,
479  *   skip_index?: boolean,
480  *   timeoutMs?: number,
481  *   roadmap_id?: string,
482  *   event_id?: string,
483  *   beforeFlush?: Function,
484  *   appendOpts?: object,
485  * }} [opts]
486  */
487 /** The step a close event closes (one not already done), with its goal re-read, else null. */
488 function closeOf(event, base) {
489   let step_id = null, goal_reread = null;
490   if (event?.kind === 'status_flip' && event.to === 'done') {
491     step_id = event.step_id; goal_reread = event.goal_reread ?? null;
492   } else if (event?.kind === 'refinement_update' && event.operation?.action === 'close') {
493     step_id = event.operation.step_id; goal_reread = event.operation.goal_reread ?? null;
494   } else return null;
495   const steps = Array.isArray(base?.roadmap_projection) ? base.roadmap_projection : [];
496   const step = steps.find((st) => st && st.id === step_id);
497   if (step && step.status === 'done') return null;      // already closed: nothing to demand, no second flip
498   return { step_id, goal_reread };
499 }
500 
501 export const GOAL_REREAD = Object.freeze(['reaffirmed', 'rewritten']);
502 
503 /** A steward's close: the strip must name the step that follows with its next and why (within the caps), and the close its goal re-read. */
504 export function demandClose(root, base, step_id, goal_reread) {
505   const closing = closeOf({ kind: 'status_flip', to: 'done', step_id, goal_reread }, base);
506   if (!closing) return { ok: true, demanded: false };
507   const demand = demandSpineForClose(root, base, step_id);
508   if (!demand.ok) return demand;
509   if (!GOAL_REREAD.includes(goal_reread)) {
510     return {
511       ok: false, error: 'goal_reread_required', closing: step_id,
512       message: 'Close refused: re-read the North Star and say so - --goal-reread reaffirmed|rewritten '
513         + '(or goal_reread on the refinement close operation); the engine records the goal_flip.',
514     };
515   }
516   return { ok: true, demanded: true };
517 }
518 
519 /** No strip (legacy) or no open step left after the close: nothing to demand. */
520 export function demandSpineForClose(root, base, step_id) {
521   const stripPath = path.join(root, 'strip.json');
522   if (!fs.existsSync(stripPath)) return { ok: true, demanded: false };
523   let strip;
524   try { strip = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(stripPath, 'utf8')); } catch { return { ok: true, demanded: false }; }
525   if (!strip || typeof strip !== 'object') return { ok: true, demanded: false };
526   const steps = Array.isArray(base?.roadmap_projection) ? base.roadmap_projection : [];
527   const open = steps.filter((st) => st && st.id !== step_id && !['done', 'parked'].includes(st.status));
528   if (!open.length) return { ok: true, demanded: false, campaign_done: true };
529   const pinned = typeof strip.current_step_id === 'string' ? strip.current_step_id.trim() : '';
530   const stale = pinned === step_id;
531   const missing = [...(pinned && !stale ? [] : ['current_step_id']), ...missingSpine(strip)];
532   if (missing.length) {
533     return {
534       ok: false, error: 'spine_required', closing: step_id, missing,
535       message: (stale ? 'current_step_id is still the step being closed. ' : '')
536         + 'Close refused: first pin the step that follows and say what comes next - '
537         + 'ecgberht update --current-step <id> --next-recommended "<up to 15 words>" --strip-why-next "<up to 20 words>" - then close. '
538         + 'A campaign with no open step left needs no next.',
539     };
540   }
541   for (const field of ['next_recommended', 'why_next']) {
542     const over = overCap(field, strip[field]);
543     if (over) return { ok: false, error: 'over_cap', ...over, closing: step_id, message: `${field} on the strip is ${over.words} words; the cap is ${over.cap}. Say it shorter, then close.` };
544   }
545   return { ok: true, demanded: true };
546 }

548 export function appendRoadmapEventThroughSpine(projectPath, event, opts = {}) {
549   const storeGate = assertStoreDeclared('roadmap_events');
550   if (!storeGate.ok) return storeGate;
551 
552   if (!event || typeof event !== 'object' || Array.isArray(event)) {
553     return spineFailure(SPINE_CODE.STATE_UNKNOWN, { error: 'event_not_object' });
554   }
555 
556   // Kind gate: keep SPINE_KIND_REFUSED + allow-list text, but preserve the pure
557   // law's error identity (`unknown_roadmap_event_kind`) so durable callers
558   // (appendRoadmapEventDurable / single-writer law) still see the authority
559   // refusal they always refused — Wave 6 must not rename pure-law refusals.
560   const kindGate = assertEventKindAllowed(event.kind);
561   if (!kindGate.ok) {
562     return {
563       ...kindGate,
564       error: 'unknown_roadmap_event_kind',
565       event_kinds: [...SPINE_EVENT_KINDS],
566     };
567   }
568 
569   const root = path.resolve(projectPath);
570   const ledgerPath = roadmapLedgerPath(root);
571   const flushIndex = shouldFlushPortfolioIndex(opts);
572 
573   const timeoutMs = opts.timeoutMs ?? LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS;
574 
575   let lockedResult;
576   try {
577     lockedResult = withFileLock(
578       ledgerPath,
579       () => {
580         // LOAD under the lock (whole-file RMW serialisation). Always prefer the
581         // on-disk ledger when present so concurrent OS processes serialise
582         // correctly; seed is only used to initialise a missing file.
583         const loaded = loadProjectRoadmap(root);
584         if (!loaded.ok && loaded.exists) {
585           return spineFailure(SPINE_CODE.LEDGER_UNREADABLE, {
586             error: 'backing-store-unreadable',
587             detail: loaded.message ?? loaded.error,
588           });
589         }
590         let base;
591         if (loaded.exists) {
592           base = loaded.roadmap;
593         } else if (opts.seed != null && opts.seed !== undefined) {
594           base = opts.seed;
595         } else {
596           base = emptyRoadmap(opts.project_id ?? null);
597         }
598 
599         if (event.kind === 'refinement_update') {
600           const prior = findEventByClientId(base,event.client_event_id);
601           if (!prior) {
602             if (event.operation?.expected_seq !== base.roadmap_events.length) return {ok:false,error:'sequence-conflict',expected_seq:event.operation?.expected_seq,actual_seq:base.roadmap_events.length};
603             const prepared=prepareRefinementEvent(root,base,event);
604             if(!prepared.ok) return prepared;
605             event=prepared.event;
606           }
607         } else if (event.kind === 'status_flip' && event.to === 'done' && foldRefinements(base.roadmap_events).slices?.[event.step_id]) {
608           return {ok:false,error:'managed-slice-requires-explicit-close'};
609         }
610         let law = appendRoadmapEventSpineLaw(base, event, { at: opts.at });
611         if (!law.ok) return law;
612         // an accepted close that carries its goal re-read gets its goal_flip from the one writer
613         const closing = closeOf(event, base);
614         let goalFlip = null;
615         if (closing && GOAL_REREAD.includes(closing.goal_reread) && !law.idempotent) {
616           let face = '';
617           try { face = fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, FACE_FILE_NAME), 'utf8'); } catch { face = ''; }
618           goalFlip = {
619             kind: 'goal_flip', step_id: closing.step_id, verdict: closing.goal_reread,
620             goal_revision: northStarRevision(face), scope: closing.step_id,
621             receipt: { who: event.receipt?.who ?? event.operation?.human?.who ?? 'steward', why: 'close of ' + closing.step_id },
622             ...(opts.at ? { at: opts.at } : {}),
623           };
624           const flipLaw = appendRoadmapEventSpineLaw(law.roadmap, goalFlip, { at: opts.at });
625           if (!flipLaw.ok) return flipLaw;
626           law = { ...law, roadmap: flipLaw.roadmap, projection: flipLaw.projection, goal_flip: flipLaw.event };
627         }
628         if (law.idempotent) {
629           const publication=event.kind==='refinement_update' ? publishRefinementProjections(root,law.roadmap) : null;
630           if(publication && !publication.ok) return {...publication,committed:true,operation_id:event.client_event_id};
631           return {
632             ...law,
633             projection_status:publication,
634             project_path: root,
635             roadmap_path: ledgerPath,
636             persisted: false,
637             sot_written: false,
638             locked: true,
639           };
640         }
641 
642         // Persist under the same lock
643         fs.mkdirSync(root, { recursive: true });
644         writeFileAtomicSync(ledgerPath, projectRoadmapBytes(law.roadmap));
645         let publication=null;
646         if(event.kind==='refinement_update') {
647           try { publication=publishRefinementProjections(root,law.roadmap); }
648           catch(e) { return {ok:false,error:'projection-lag',committed:true,operation_id:event.client_event_id,detail:e.message}; }
649           if(!publication.ok) return {...publication,committed:true,operation_id:event.client_event_id};
650         }
651 
652         let carrier = null;
653         let carrierRel = null;
654         let carrierBytes = null;
655         if (flushIndex) {
656           carrier = roadmapEventCarrierRecord(law.roadmap, law.event, opts);
657           carrierRel = relPathFor(CLASS.ROADMAP_EVENT, carrier.event_id);
658           carrierBytes = roadmapEventBytes(carrier);
659           const carrierAbs = path.join(root, ...carrierRel.split('/'));
660           fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(carrierAbs), { recursive: true });
661           writeFileAtomicSync(carrierAbs, carrierBytes);
662         }
663 
664         return {
665           ok: true,
666           projection_status:publication,
667           spelling: law.spelling,
668           authority: law.authority,
669           event: law.event,
670           roadmap: law.roadmap,
671           projection: law.projection,
672           issues: law.issues,
673           events_only: true,
674           spine: true,
675           idempotent: false,
676           seq: law.event.seq,
677           client_event_id: law.event.client_event_id ?? null,
678           project_path: root,
679           roadmap_path: ledgerPath,
680           persisted: true,
681           sot_written: true,
682           locked: true,
683           single_writer: SPINE_SINGLE_WRITER,
684           carrier,
685           carrier_rel: carrierRel,
686           carrier_bytes: carrierBytes,
687           container_bytes: projectRoadmapBytes(law.roadmap),
688         };
689       },
690       {
691         timeoutMs,
692         onTimeout: (info) => {
693           const err = new Error(SPINE_TEXT[SPINE_CODE.LOCK_TIMEOUT]);
694           err.code = SPINE_CODE.LOCK_TIMEOUT;
695           err.spine_info = info;
696           return err;
697         },
698       },
699     );
700   } catch (e) {
701     if (e && e.code === SPINE_CODE.LOCK_TIMEOUT) {
702       return spineFailure(SPINE_CODE.LOCK_TIMEOUT, {
703         error: 'lock-contended',
704       });
705     }
706     if (e && e.code === 'ELOCKTIMEOUT') {
707       return spineFailure(SPINE_CODE.LOCK_TIMEOUT, {
708         error: 'lock-contended',
709       });
710     }
711     return spineFailure(SPINE_CODE.STATE_UNKNOWN, {
712       error: 'unknown',
713       detail: String(e?.message ?? e),
714     });
715   }
716 
717   if (!lockedResult || !lockedResult.ok) return lockedResult;
718   if (lockedResult.idempotent) return lockedResult;
719 
720   // Optional portfolio index flush OUTSIDE the roadmap lock (lock-order law:
721   // never hold project + portfolio locks together). Carrier bytes were written
722   // under the roadmap lock; ingestWrite re-writes the carrier (idempotent
723   // atomic replace) and flushes the derived row. Only minted project_ids index.
724   if (flushIndex && lockedResult.carrier && lockedResult.carrier_rel) {
725     const containerBytes = lockedResult.container_bytes;
726     let ingest;
727     try {
728       ingest = ingestWrite({
729         class: CLASS.ROADMAP_EVENT,
730         project_id: opts.project_id,
731         root,
732         rel: lockedResult.carrier_rel,
733         bytes: lockedResult.carrier_bytes,
734         intent_paths: [pathEntryFor(ROADMAP_FILE_NAME, containerBytes)],
735         home: opts.home,
736         paths: opts.paths,
737         env: opts.env,
738         appendOpts: opts.appendOpts,
739         beforeFlush: opts.beforeFlush,
740         // Carrier already durable under the spine lock; re-assert atomically.
741         write: (target) => {
742           fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(target.abs), { recursive: true });
743           writeFileAtomicSync(target.abs, target.bytes.toString('utf8'));
744         },
745       });
746     } catch (e) {
747       // SoT already stands; never throw past the durable path.
748       return {
749         ...lockedResult,
750         ok: true,
751         indexed: false,
752         sot_written: true,
753         index_error: e?.code ?? 'ingest_threw',
754         message:
755           `Spine append seq=${lockedResult.seq} durable; index flush refused: ${e?.message ?? e}`,
756       };
757     }
758 
759     return {
760       ...lockedResult,
761       ok: ingest.ok === true,
762       code: ingest.code ?? null,
763       status: ingest.status ?? null,
764       text: ingest.text ?? '',
765       ingest,
766       indexed: ingest.ok === true,
767       row: ingest.row ?? null,
768       seq_indexed: ingest.seq ?? null,
769       intent: ingest.intent ?? null,
770       intent_seq: ingest.intent_seq ?? null,
771       intent_emitted: ingest.intent_emitted === true,
772       freshness: ingest.freshness,
773       path: ingest.path ?? null,
774       trace: ingest.trace ?? [],
775       // SoT stands even when index fails
776       sot_written: true,
777       message:
778         ingest.ok === true
779           ? `Spine append seq=${lockedResult.seq} durable + indexed.`
780           : `Spine append seq=${lockedResult.seq} durable; index flush: ${ingest.text || ingest.code}`,
781     };
782   }
783 
784   return {
785     ...lockedResult,
786     indexed: false,
787     message: `Spine append seq=${lockedResult.seq} durable under ${SPINE_LOCK_HELPER}+${SPINE_ATOMIC_WRITE}.`,
788   };
789 }
790 
791 /**
792  * Persist an already-computed roadmap container under the spine lock.
793  * Used only when a pure multi-event fold finished in memory and must land
794  * atomically (e.g. E7 multi-step record). Prefer appendRoadmapEventThroughSpine
795  * for single-event production appends.
796  *
797  * @param {string} projectPath
798  * @param {object} roadmap
799  * @param {{ timeoutMs?: number }} [opts]
800  */
801 export function writeRoadmapThroughSpine(projectPath, roadmap, opts = {}) {
802   const storeGate = assertStoreDeclared('roadmap_events');
803   if (!storeGate.ok) return storeGate;
804 
805   const root = path.resolve(projectPath);
806   const ledgerPath = roadmapLedgerPath(root);
807 
808   try {
809     withFileLock(
810       ledgerPath,
811       () => {
812         const current=loadProjectRoadmap(root);
813         if ((roadmap.roadmap_events || []).some(e=>e.kind==='refinement_update') ||
814             (current.roadmap?.roadmap_events || []).some(e=>e.kind==='refinement_update')) {
815           const error=new Error('Managed roadmap replacement requires the refinement append operation');
816           error.code='managed-write-refused'; throw error;
817         }
818         fs.mkdirSync(root, { recursive: true });
819         writeFileAtomicSync(ledgerPath, projectRoadmapBytes(roadmap));
820       },
821       {
822         timeoutMs: opts.timeoutMs ?? LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS,
823         onTimeout: (info) => {
824           const err = new Error(SPINE_TEXT[SPINE_CODE.LOCK_TIMEOUT]);
825           err.code = SPINE_CODE.LOCK_TIMEOUT;
826           err.spine_info = info;
827           return err;
828         },
829       },
830     );
831   } catch (e) {
832     if(e?.code==='managed-write-refused') return {ok:false,error:e.code};
833     if (e && (e.code === SPINE_CODE.LOCK_TIMEOUT || e.code === 'ELOCKTIMEOUT')) {
834       return spineFailure(SPINE_CODE.LOCK_TIMEOUT, { error: 'lock-contended' });
835     }
836     return spineFailure(SPINE_CODE.STATE_UNKNOWN, {
837       error: 'unknown',
838       detail: String(e?.message ?? e),
839     });
840   }
841 
842   return {
843     ok: true,
844     roadmap_path: ledgerPath,
845     project_path: root,
846     spine: true,
847     single_writer: SPINE_SINGLE_WRITER,
848     sot_written: true,
849   };
850 }

852 /**
853  * Supported managed repair. No caller-supplied replacement or event mutation:
854  * reload and derive both cached projections under the existing writer lock.
855  * Normal appends and container replacements retain their drift/refusal guards.
856  */
857 export function repairRoadmapProjectionsThroughSpine(projectPath, opts = {}) {
858   const storeGate=assertStoreDeclared('roadmap_events');
859   if(!storeGate.ok) return storeGate;
860   const root=path.resolve(projectPath),ledgerPath=roadmapLedgerPath(root);
861   let repair;
862   try {
863     return withFileLock(ledgerPath,()=>{
864       const loaded=loadProjectRoadmap(root);
865       if(!loaded.ok || !loaded.exists) return {ok:false,error:'backing-store-unreadable'};
866       const base=loaded.roadmap,state=foldRefinements(base.roadmap_events);
867       if(!state.managed) return {ok:false,error:'unmanaged-campaign'};
868       const healed=healRoadmap(base);
869       if(!healed.ok) return healed;
870       const roadmap={...healed.roadmap,refinement_projection:state};
871       const valid=refinementRoadmapStatus(roadmap);
872       if(!valid.consistent) return {ok:false,error:valid.error,issues:valid.issues,invalid_issues:valid.invalid_issues};
873       // Authenticate every document before any repair write. An external edit
874       // is a conflict, even when a cached roadmap projection also needs repair.
875       const documents=refinementProjectionStatus(root,base);
876       if(documents.error) return {ok:false,...documents};
877       const changed=['roadmap_projection','refinement_projection'].filter(
878         field=>JSON.stringify(base[field])!==JSON.stringify(roadmap[field]));
879       repair={repaired_fields:[],
880         events_rewritten:false,locked:true,persisted:false,updated_documents:[]};
881       if(changed.length) {
882         writeFileAtomicSync(ledgerPath,projectRoadmapBytes(roadmap));
883         repair.persisted=true;
884         repair.repaired_fields=changed;
885       }
886       const publication=publishRefinementProjections(root,roadmap);
887       repair.updated_documents=publication.updated_documents || [];
888       repair.finished=publication.finished || null;
889       const saved=loadProjectRoadmap(root);
890       if(!saved.ok || !saved.exists) return {ok:false,error:'backing-store-unreadable',repair};
891       const view=refinementResult(root,saved.roadmap);
892       return {...view,ok:publication.ok && publication.consistent && view.consistent,repair,
893         ...(!publication.ok || !publication.consistent || !view.consistent ? {
894           error:publication.error || publication.finished?.error || 'projection-lag',
895           detail:publication.detail || publication.finished?.detail,
896         } : {})};
897     },{timeoutMs:opts.timeoutMs ?? LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS});
898   } catch(e) {
899     if(e?.code==='ELOCKTIMEOUT') return spineFailure(SPINE_CODE.LOCK_TIMEOUT,{error:'lock-contended'});
900     return {ok:false,error:e.code || 'projection-repair-failed',detail:e.message,...(repair ? {repair} : {})};
901   }
902 }

904 /**
905  * Persist strip.json under a named lock (S2 companion path when portfolio
906  * index is not in play). Production strip instruments/receipts prefer
907  * write-authority durable paths when project_id is available.
908  *
909  * @param {string} projectPath
910  * @param {object} strip
911  * @param {{ timeoutMs?: number, fileName?: string }} [opts]
912  */
913 export function writeStripThroughSpine(projectPath, strip, opts = {}) {
914   const storeGate = assertStoreDeclared('strip_instruments');
915   if (!storeGate.ok) return storeGate;
916 
917   const root = path.resolve(projectPath);
918   const fileName = opts.fileName ?? 'strip.json';
919   const stripPath = path.join(root, fileName);
920 
921   try {
922     withFileLock(
923       stripPath,
924       () => {
925         fs.mkdirSync(root, { recursive: true });
926         writeFileAtomicSync(stripPath, `${JSON.stringify(strip, null, 2)}\n`);
927       },
928       {
929         timeoutMs: opts.timeoutMs ?? LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS,
930         onTimeout: (info) => {
931           const err = new Error(SPINE_TEXT[SPINE_CODE.LOCK_TIMEOUT]);
932           err.code = SPINE_CODE.LOCK_TIMEOUT;
933           err.spine_info = info;
934           return err;
935         },
936       },
937     );
938   } catch (e) {
939     if (e && (e.code === SPINE_CODE.LOCK_TIMEOUT || e.code === 'ELOCKTIMEOUT')) {
940       return spineFailure(SPINE_CODE.LOCK_TIMEOUT, { error: 'lock-contended' });
941     }
942     return spineFailure(SPINE_CODE.STATE_UNKNOWN, {
943       error: 'unknown',
944       detail: String(e?.message ?? e),
945     });
946   }
947 
948   return {
949     ok: true,
950     strip_path: stripPath,
951     project_path: root,
952     spine: true,
953     sot_written: true,
954   };
955 }

957 /**
958  * Source-removal proof: spine module text must still name the durable helpers.
959  * @param {string} sourceText
960  */
961 export function assertSpineDurableHelpersPresent(sourceText) {
962   const missing = [];
963   if (!sourceText.includes('writeFileAtomicSync')) missing.push('writeFileAtomicSync');
964   if (!sourceText.includes('withFileLock')) missing.push('withFileLock');
965   if (!sourceText.includes('appendRoadmapEventThroughSpine')) {
966     missing.push('appendRoadmapEventThroughSpine');
967   }
968   return { ok: missing.length === 0, missing };
969 }

971 /**
972  * Allow-list kinds must match the roadmap module's admitted set (current version).
973  * scaffold_proposal (v1) + face_* (v2 / Wave 10) + elaboration_* (v3 / Wave 12)
974  * + reflection_receipt / next_stage_proposal (v4 / Wave 14) are on both.
975  */
976 export function assertKindsAligned() {
977   const fromRoadmap = new Set(ROADMAP_KINDS_FROM_MODULE);
978   const fromSpine = new Set(SPINE_EVENT_KINDS);
979   const missingInRoadmap = SPINE_EVENT_KINDS.filter((k) => !fromRoadmap.has(k));
980   const missingInSpine = ROADMAP_KINDS_FROM_MODULE.filter((k) => !fromSpine.has(k));
981   return {
982     ok: missingInRoadmap.length === 0 && missingInSpine.length === 0,
983     missingInRoadmap,
984     missingInSpine,
985     version: ROADMAP_EVENT_KINDS_VERSION,
986   };
987 }
